analytics.title: Carrier Portfolio Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Operational measures for the selected carriers; activity periods are based on record creation dates.
analytics.methodNote: Loads compare the last 30 days with the prior 30 days. Per-vehicle activity is compared with the median for carriers on the same plan and in the same active-fleet band. This is not a predictive health score; no historical login or feature-use event stream is available.

telematics.title: ቴሌማቲክስ
telematics.subtitle: የተሽከርካሪ አቀማመጦች ከእውነተኛ ሃርድዌር እንዲመጡ፣ ከአሽከርካሪ ስልክ ብቻ ሳይሆን — እና ምንም ንቁ ጭነት የሌላቸው ስራ ፈት ተሽከርካሪዎች እንኳ በዲስፓች ካርታ ላይ እንዲታዩ የ GPS/ቴሌማቲክስ አቅራቢ ያገናኙ።
